questions.question: What happened when the tabernacle was finished and set up?
options: The glory of the LORD filled it
It stood empty and silent for days
A sudden fire broke out within it
The pillar of cloud passed it by
questions.answer: The glory of the LORD filled it

questions.question: How did Israel know when to travel and when to stay?
options: By the loud blast of the silver war trumpets
By the word of Moses each morning
By the cloud lifting from the tabernacle
By the changing of the desert seasons
questions.answer: By the cloud lifting from the tabernacle

questions.question: A cloud covered the tent by day, and fire was in it by night.
The _____ of the LORD filled the tabernacle when the work was completed.
Whenever the _____ lifted from the tabernacle, the Israelites would set out.
